message.jaymospowers.zfighter_adrenaline: Your heart pounds and the world slows. Now!
Too many of them. Your blood roars: faster, harder!
The rush drains away, and everything aches.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_blood_ki: Out of ki: you pay %s health for it.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_reserve: Something cold and deep wakes in you.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_comeback: You were nearly done for. You are not done. Your limit rises.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_comeback_u: Back from the ground, stronger than you fell. Your limit rises.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_merge_none: There is no one here to merge with.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_merge_done: You and %s are already one in this.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_merge_mast: %s will not join with you yet: a good heart and eight lessons are needed.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_merge_offe: %s offers to merge. Face them and press sneak+Z to answer.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_merge_begi: You open yourself to %s. Stand still.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_merge_join: Their strength becomes yours, for good.
